_comment: RisingWave differs from the other engines in what the batches mean: batch 1
loads the source tables and runs dbt, which creates one MATERIALIZED VIEW per
model; batches 2 and 3 only append to those source tables. There is no dbt run
and no REFRESH in batches 2-3 — the MV graph maintains itself, and the batch
duration is the append plus the FLUSH that waits for it to propagate.
